The licence is as Commons records it. Identified as this saint because: Plate 04161 of the Russian Lives of the Saints (1903-1911), whose numbering puts it on 16 December - the folder's feast day. Captioned Aggey and filed under Category:Haggai in icons - the minor prophet of this folder. The second plate of the day, 04162, is Theophania.
